messages.subject: International Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Godbold,

Your leadership within Omera Partners' Mining & Mining Services practice makes this a focused introduction for senior mining mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a large-scale gold-mining operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where mining strategy, institutional relationships, regulatory execution, social licence and responsible development intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets alongside broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
